info.title: SIT ORBIT API
info.description: Personal Campus Agent for Shibaura Institute of Technology

get.description:
Return the authenticated Chat contract used for capability intersection.

The legacy capabilities endpoint above is intentionally untouched.  This
endpoint is a stricter, versioned advertisement for the extension and is
fail-closed for live SCombZ student reads.

Response Submit Agent Tool Result V1 Agent Runs  Run Id  Tool Results Post

ActionProposal.title: ActionProposal
ActionProposal.description: An evidence-backed next action that remains a proposal until approved.

AgentCapabilities.title: AgentCapabilities
AgentCapabilities.description: Authenticated runtime capabilities used before personal data leaves Chrome.

AgentRunRequest.title: AgentRunRequest
AgentRunRequest.description:
Start one explicit proposal run.

``client_tools`` is only a capability advertisement.  The server never
uses it to access Google; a connected extension must complete the deferred
tool call and send the minimized derived result back.

AgentSessionRequest.title: AgentSessionRequest
AgentSessionRequest.description: One-time Google authorization material used to create an Agent session.

AgentSessionResponse.title: AgentSessionResponse
AgentSessionResponse.description: An opaque, short-lived bearer token for Agent API requests.

AgentToolResultRequest.title: AgentToolResultRequest
AgentToolResultRequest.description:
Result for one registered external tool.

The envelope repeats the call name and version so a result cannot be
accidentally delivered to a different deferred tool.  The validator also
keeps the two strict result schemas from being mixed across tools.

BrowserReadLink.title: BrowserReadLink
BrowserReadLink.description: A visible link projection; it has no DOM or form state.

BrowserReadResult.title: BrowserReadResult
BrowserReadResult.description: Visible text from a user-authorized URL, bounded for model context.

CalendarAvailabilityInterval.title: CalendarAvailabilityInterval
CalendarAvailabilityInterval.description: One derived free-time interval, without calendar event details.

CalendarAvailabilityResult.title: CalendarAvailabilityResult
CalendarAvailabilityResult.description:
Minimal v1 result accepted from the extension's Calendar connector.

Event IDs, titles, attendees, locations, descriptions, and raw Google
responses deliberately have no representation in this model.

CastAlumniReadResult.title: CastAlumniReadResult
CastAlumniReadResult.description:
Generalized CAST supporter data with no person or contact fields.

The extension keeps the authenticated page and local detail card.  Only
these bounded categories cross the Chat API; names, contact values, CAST
identifiers, URLs, and free text have no representation here.

CastReadResult.title: CastReadResult
CastReadResult.description:
Derived CAST dashboard counts safe for an explicitly confirmed run.

Notice text, career preferences, application history, user identity, and
submitted documents deliberately have no representation in this model.

CastSearchResult.title: CastSearchResult
CastSearchResult.description:
Aggregate-only projection returned by the authenticated CAST search tool.

Company/person detail remains in the extension's local result card.  This
schema intentionally has no company code, person identifier, HTML, or
source URL field.

ChatCapabilities.title: ChatCapabilities
ChatCapabilities.description:
Authenticated capability advertisement for the Chat extension.

The legacy ``/v1/capabilities`` response intentionally remains stable for
older clients.  Chat clients use this richer projection to compute the
intersection of locally available tools and the deployed server contract.

ChatContextManifest.title: ChatContextManifest
ChatContextManifest.description: Typed, short-lived public context supplied by the extension.

ChatLibraryContextRecord.title: ChatLibraryContextRecord
ChatLibraryContextRecord.description:
A bounded public OPAC record carried between Chat turns.

This is deliberately separate from the transcript.  It contains only
the structured, public projection that the next model turn may use to
resolve elliptical follow-ups such as ``"どこにある？"``.

ChatRunBackground.title: ChatRunBackground
ChatRunBackground.description: Acknowledgement for a bounded in-memory background chat run.

ClientTool.title: ClientTool
ClientTool.description: A capability explicitly advertised by the client for one run.

EvidenceLink.title: EvidenceLink
EvidenceLink.description: A compact link to the evidence used by an action proposal.

LegacyMyLibraryReadResult.title: LegacyMyLibraryReadResult
LegacyMyLibraryReadResult.description: The original aggregate-only My Library result shape.

LibraryActionOption.title: LibraryActionOption
LibraryActionOption.description: One current-provider action capability for an opaque resource.

LibraryActionOptionsResult.title: LibraryActionOptionsResult
LibraryActionOptionsResult.description: Read-only action capabilities derived from the current official page.

LibraryBibliographicRecord.title: LibraryBibliographicRecord
LibraryBibliographicRecord.description: Public bibliographic metadata and rendered holdings from the OPAC.

LibraryCatalogBrowseResult.title: LibraryCatalogBrowseResult
LibraryCatalogBrowseResult.description: Public new-book or loan-ranking rows from the official catalog pages.

LibraryCatalogSearchResult.title: LibraryCatalogSearchResult
LibraryCatalogSearchResult.description: Bounded public results from the official OPAC search form.

LibraryDiscoveryItem.title: LibraryDiscoveryItem
LibraryDiscoveryItem.description:
Displayed public metadata/link from the official SIT Search page.

This schema intentionally has no full-text, download, or persistence field.

LibraryDiscoverySearchResult.title: LibraryDiscoverySearchResult
LibraryDiscoverySearchResult.description: Bounded metadata-only results from official SIT Search.

LibraryHoldingSummary.title: LibraryHoldingSummary
LibraryHoldingSummary.description:
Public holding status rendered by the official OPAC.

Internal material, copy, and holding identifiers deliberately have no
representation in this model.

LibraryItemReadResult.title: LibraryItemReadResult
LibraryItemReadResult.description: Detailed public OPAC record resolved from an opaque resource reference.

LibraryRelatedRecordRef.title: LibraryRelatedRecordRef
LibraryRelatedRecordRef.description: A public related-record reference without material identifiers.

MoodleReadResult.title: MoodleReadResult
MoodleReadResult.description:
Derived Moodle dashboard counts safe for an explicitly confirmed run.

Course names, activity titles, course IDs, user identity, submission data,
and source HTML deliberately have no representation in this model.

MyLibraryItem.title: MyLibraryItem
MyLibraryItem.description:
One bounded personal-library row safe to share after session consent.

The connector maps provider-specific identifiers to an opaque reference
before this model is constructed.  Material/request IDs, call numbers,
form values, and account identity intentionally have no fields here.

OrbitEvent.title: OrbitEvent
OrbitEvent.description: An observed event in the student's campus journey.

RelatedBookCandidate.title: RelatedBookCandidate
RelatedBookCandidate.description: Public, evidence-grounded candidate produced by bounded discovery.

RelatedBookCatalogVerification.title: RelatedBookCatalogVerification
RelatedBookCatalogVerification.description: Latest SIT OPAC verification state for one public candidate.

RelatedBookRelationAxis.title: RelatedBookRelationAxis
RelatedBookRelationAxis.description: One bounded explanation axis used to diversify book discovery.

ScombzCoverage.title: ScombzCoverage
ScombzCoverage.description: Bounded coverage report for cross-course SCombZ reads.

ScombzPageSummaryResult.title: ScombzPageSummaryResult
ScombzPageSummaryResult.description:
A minimized summary of the currently displayed ScombZ page.

This deliberately has no title, URL, course name, item, link, HTML, or
browser token field.  The tool name and version are carried by the
surrounding deferred-tool result envelope.

ScombzReadAnnouncement.title: ScombzReadAnnouncement
ScombzReadAnnouncement.description: A visible announcement projection without its raw link or markup.

ScombzReadResult.title: ScombzReadResult
ScombzReadResult.description:
Structured SCombZ information returned after an explicit user run.

Restricted grade/attendance values have no representation here.  A
connector can report their presence so the UI can ask for confirmation,
but it cannot forward those values through this result schema.

ScombzReadTask.title: ScombzReadTask
ScombzReadTask.description: A visible SCombZ assignment projection without HTML or identifiers.

ScopedMyLibraryReadResult.title: ScopedMyLibraryReadResult
ScopedMyLibraryReadResult.description: A complete, bounded page for exactly one My Library scope.

SitrusGradeItem.title: SitrusGradeItem
SitrusGradeItem.description: One minimized grade row extracted from the displayed SITRUS notice.

SitrusGradeResult.title: SitrusGradeResult
SitrusGradeResult.description: In-memory SITRUS projection; the PDF and student identity are omitted.

SyllabusResult.title: SyllabusResult
SyllabusResult.description: One result from the official public syllabus search.

SyllabusSearchResult.title: SyllabusSearchResult
SyllabusSearchResult.description: A bounded public result set from the official syllabus search.
